supersedes: v0.17.0 (abandoned broken line; archived on archive/0.17-broken-line)
strategy: reuse bundled official Pandoc engine with Qingye GUI
aiCollaboration: opt-in; loopback OpenAPI tool server off by default
interfaceStyles: MacOS (drawn traffic lights, rounded corners, glass; optional Windows 11 acrylic)
acceptance: 0.20.0: verify passed, 141 unit tests with one POSIX-only skip; backend 98 tasks; 9 source and 7 packaged smoke suites passed, as recorded in HANDOFF.md.
Installer was not installed on a clean system; Android and macOS were not rebuilt for 0.20.0.
newFeatures: Fixes from the 0.19.1 review: draft kept during a canceled save, library snippets and long-note indexing, Office cache cancellation, compare of dense identical pages, PPT aspect ratio and DPI
One Office-to-PDF path (LibreOffice) in every entry; OCR adds a text layer only, recognises mixed pages and regions
Visual page manager, annotation & excerpt panel with tags, unified task center with queue and version binding, document workspaces and pinned documents
engineeringChanges: Static analysis: oxlint with correctness rules only (npm run lint, npm run verify); CI runs lint before the unit tests
Tests are discovered by glob (test/*.test.*) instead of a hand-maintained list; npm run test:coverage added

test/consistency.test.mjs: version stated in five places must agree, Android versionName/versionCode must match mobile/package.json, every top-level .cjs must be listed in build.files and every listed file must exist
main.cjs split 818 -> 616 lines into qingye-protocol.cjs, window-shell.cjs, installer-hooks.cjs, office-task.cjs, reference-ipc.cjs
ui/app.mjs split 713 -> 558 lines into ui/recent-list.mjs, ui/theme.mjs, ui/draft-recovery.mjs, ui/shortcuts.mjs, ui/commands.mjs, ui/history-ui.mjs
Library search: Markdown paragraph line numbers counted incrementally (was O(n^2) per query) and folded text cached (24 MB cap)
fixes: Library search: a long Markdown note recomputed every paragraph's line number from the start of the document on every keystroke; the folded index text was rebuilt for each query
notBuilt: Android and macOS were not rebuilt for 0.20.0 (no mobile changes; macOS needs the GitHub Actions runners)
